release_notes: V14.44 build 256 adds a local sound-status indicator to the bottom-left of the night screen. A green dot with SOUND ON indicates that the local buzzer master is enabled, while a red dot with SOUND OFF indicates that it is disabled. The indicator follows the saved Web UI and physical-button buzzer setting and is also displayed on the night-mode NO The indicator follows the saved Web UI and physical-button buzzer setting and is also displayed on the night-mode NO DATA screen. Temporary alarm snoozing does not change the master sound indicator. The user-configurable 5-to-30-minute NO DATA timeout, Nightscout verification, working local alias sequence, OTA progress, trend recovery, alarms, WhatsApp alerts, IOB, COB and ketone functions remain preserved.
